gpu_selection: three observations; prioritize free memory, then utilization; shared GPU authorized
train_reduction: valid-scalar-weighted microbatch objectives, accumulated to 256 windows; Corr is per microbatch
validation_selection: complete-trial equal average of branch objective
force_label_preprocessing: native CMCU/BSQ units and timestamps; no extra force lowpass, MA7, clipping or post-hoc time shifting
calibration: first eligible complete test5 press per finger; in-domain monotone PAVA; no future source, no fallback
scoring: test5 scoring presses exclude all calibration fit points; test7 nonthumb routing; common calibrated-domain/finite mask across experiments
gpu_memory_policy: per-process ceiling=min(32 GiB, round_down_to_4GiB(0.65*(observed_free_GiB-8GiB))); at least16GiB budget for benchmark
